_metadata.description: P0 requirements for Code Facts target resolution, fact selection, evidence status, proof synthesis, cache, and programmatic surfaces.

requirements.title: Resolve bounded code targets
requirements.description: Resolve path, scenario, module, and project targets into a canonical root, target kind, optional scenario context, language filter, and evidence-backed diagnostics.

validation.notes: Target resolver tests cover scenario:<name>, path-inside-scenario, generic Go module, generic TS project, explicit tsconfig, and unsupported path.
code-facts describe --include surfaces,parse_units returns target context without calling providers.

requirements.title: Inventory scenario surfaces and parse units
requirements.description: Report Vrooli scenario API, CLI, UI, sidecar, endpoint, and generic parse-unit facts with known/missing/unsupported/ambiguous/unknown statuses.

validation.notes: Service tests cover generated scenario API/CLI/UI surface inventory, sidecar unsupported status, generic Go modules, generic TypeScript projects, and paths inside scenario surfaces.
test-genie execute code-facts business --json confirms this requirement maps to OT-P0-002 and the registry validates structurally.

requirements.title: Broker supported analyzer providers
requirements.description: Route Go parse units to go-code-graph and TypeScript parse units to typescript-code-graph through provider seams; Code Facts must not parse supported source files itself.

validation.notes: Fake provider tests verify routing, provider failure mapping, strict-mode provider errors, and unsupported parse units.
Code Facts Phase 13 live check ran code-facts facts describe scenario:proto-health --include all --no-cache --json against running go-code-graph and typescript-code-graph providers.

requirements.title: Filter describe output by fact family
requirements.description: Describe requests include explicit fact-family filters and responses contain only requested families plus required context, warnings, and unsupported-family evidence.

validation.notes: Provider-backed unit tests verify imports-only and calls-only requests omit unrelated provider facts; proof-only and CLI filtering remain planned.
UI and API tests assert fact-family include selections are propagated and unrelated families are omitted from filtered describe output.

requirements.title: Use explicit evidence statuses
requirements.description: Every high-level proof and unsupported condition uses one of proven, missing, contradicted, unsupported, or unknown with source evidence.

validation.notes: Proof synthesis tests cover proven, missing, contradicted, unsupported, and unknown-oriented evidence paths.

requirements.title: Prove proto adoption facts
requirements.description: Detect generated proto adoption in Go API/CLI and TypeScript UI surfaces from import/reference/call facts, including missing and unsupported cases.

validation.notes: API tests cover Go generated imports by surface and missing adoption outcomes. TS generated import proof uses the same normalized import path matcher.

requirements.title: Prove Go REST endpoint implementation facts
requirements.description: Synthesize endpoint proof facts for Go REST handlers using generic call/type/import usage facts from go-code-graph.

validation.notes: API tests cover protojson response construction, error envelope usage, and contradicted declaration from wrong response type.

requirements.title: Expose deterministic cache diagnostics
requirements.description: Cache keys include analyzer version, target root, options, config hashes, source hashes, graph hash, and requested family; responses expose hit/miss/stale reason metadata.

validation.notes: Cache tests verify repeated describe reuse, source-hash invalidation, status entries, and dry-run clear semantics.
Connect API and CLI expose status, inspect, and clear operations with cache key/hash metadata.

requirements.title: Maintain API and CLI parity
requirements.description: Connect API and CLI expose equivalent describe, surfaces, proto-adoption, endpoint-proof, and cache status/inspect/clear operations.

validation.notes: Endpoint generation tests assert the CLI manifest contains the eight facts/cache operations backed by CodeFactsService endpoints.
CLI package tests and live Phase 13 command execution cover JSON output for describe/proof/cache operations through generated Connect clients.

requirements.title: Inspect evidence in the operator UI
requirements.description: UI lets operators inspect target context, surfaces, parse units, fact families, warnings, evidence statuses, provider provenance, and cache state.

validation.notes: FactsWorkbench tests cover target entry, include filtering, populated evidence/fact/surface/parse-unit tables, warnings, cache panel, path targets, cache preference, and error states.
